blueprint.name: Intelligent AI Load Balancing Demo
blueprint.description: 3-model Bedrock backend behind a BNK Gateway with F5BigAnalyzer for live traffic-weighted routing. Includes a load generator so weight shifts are visible in real time. Requires BNK 2.2 platform deployed.

estimated_cost: Pay-per-use Bedrock (~$0.035/M input tokens on Nova Micro)
outcomes: 3 single-model Bedrock shim pods (Nova Micro, Nova Lite, Claude 3 Haiku) behind a BNK Gateway
HTTPRoute with 3 weighted backendRefs — analyzer mutates weights live
F5BigAnalyzer CR (Path A builtin LLMLoadMonitor) reading Prometheus
vllm:* backend metrics + smartllm_client_* client metrics in Prometheus
Poisson-paced client sending varied prompts from a ConfigMap prompt bank
Dashboard Traffic Distribution tile shifts live as the analyzer weights

prerequisites.description: EKS cluster with the OIDC provider enabled (required for IRSA)
BNK platform deployed — must have bnk-gatewayclass + programmed external VLAN with a free VIP
prerequisites.name: bnk-on-k8s

prerequisites.description: Prometheus operator installed. ServiceMonitors use label release: kube-prometheus-stack by default — override prometheus_release_label on both modules if different.
prerequisites.name: kube-prometheus-stack

prerequisites.description: AWS account with Bedrock model access granted for Nova Micro, Nova Lite, and Claude 3 Haiku in the target region. Pre-check per region — Nova and Haiku availability varies.

modules.name: Bedrock IAM Role (IRSA)
modules.description: Creates the IAM role the backend shim pods assume via IRSA to call Bedrock (Nova Micro, Nova Lite, Claude 3 Haiku). role_name auto-derives from project name to avoid shared-account collisions. Output role_arn auto-wires into the backend module.

modules.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM Backend
modules.description: 3 Bedrock shim pods + BNK Gateway + HTTPRoute + F5BigAnalyzer CR, deployed in default namespace by default. bedrock_role_arn auto-wires from the IRSA module output.

modules.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM Client
modules.description: Poisson-paced load generator sending varied prompts to the Gateway VIP from a separate namespace
